description:
Whether the company can issue right now, and if not, what to fix.

Call it before a company's first document, and when issuing
fails for a reason that is not the document's. ready is false
with missing naming the cause; by_document_type has it per nfe
and nfse, each blocker with the fields at fault and each warning
a default being declared; fix_url is the dashboard screen for
the first blocker.

What to do with it:
- address: offer to fill it in here. Read the company's own
  registry row with lookup_taxpayer, show the user the address,
  and call update_company once they confirm.
- state_registration: ask the user for the IE, then
  update_company.
- certificate, certificate_expired, certificate_unreadable, plan:
  only the dashboard fixes them; give the user fix_url.
- update_company refused for lack of company:write: give fix_url
  and tell the user to reconnect Stackin to allow company
  settings.

Do not call it again until something changed — an update_company,
or the user saying they fixed it: the answer will be the same.
Also the certificate's expiry, the tax regime (CRT), the state,
the default série per document type and what the registry
suggests for the fiscal fields. Read-only.

company_id.description: UUID of the company acted for. Omit it if the connection covers a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. company_id or company_tax_id, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company acted for, never the recipient or a taxpayer looked up. Omit it if the connection covers a single company; else see list_authorized_companies. company_id or company_tax_id, never both.

name: get_company_readiness

outputSchema.description: Whether the company can issue right now, and if not, why.

by_document_type.description: Per nfe/nfse: ready, missing [{code, fields}] with the fields at fault, and warnings [{code}] for a default being declared (tax_regime_default, simples_nacional_default, service_code_default).

default_series.description: The série used per document type when none is sent.

fix_url.description: The dashboard screen that fixes the first blocker. Null when nothing blocks.

missing.description: Why not: certificate, certificate_expired, certificate_unreadable, address, state_registration, plan. Empty when ready.

ready.description: At least one document type can be issued.

suggested_fiscal_fields.description: What the CNPJ registry suggests for tax_regime and simples_nacional. A suggestion for the user to confirm, never applied.

tax_regime.description: CRT: 1 Simples, 2 Simples excesso, 3 normal, 4 MEI.
